core.headline: Two-bedroom first-floor flat with lift and allocated parking
core.listing:
A two-bedroom first-floor purpose-built flat in Chatham with lift access and one allocated parking space. The accommodation includes an open-plan kitchen/living room with Juliet balcony.

The ground floor provides a communal entrance with lift. The first floor offers an open-plan kitchen/living room with Juliet balcony, two bedrooms and a bathroom.

Outside, there is one allocated parking space.

Chatham is located on New Road in Medway.

The flat is offered at a guide price of £195,000 and is held leasehold with 99 years remaining on the lease. The service charge is £1,450 per year (year ending March 2026). Council Tax band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. The property has mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. FTTC broadband is available and there is good outdoor mobile signal coverage on major networks. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield or mining matters: none known.
